source_scope: Eight document UI rows only; documents are global resources, not Agent leases

requirements: Compiled real web, actual two-AM HTTP transport and three distinct authenticated subjects
Real isolated Playwright contexts, route.fetch, clipboard and download support
Actual request-ID and serving-ingress evidence; no synthetic successful responses

user-fixtures.setup_export: setups[name](ctx, primitives); shared author-scoped adapter calls the export

primitives.identities: {user,recipient,outsider}, each {actor: configured transport/browser actor name, subject: exact authenticated subject}. Subjects must differ. No credentials in this contract.

disposableDatabase.reserve: async ({purpose:'documents',caseId}) -> lease before any public mutation

lease.retainIntent: async ({actor,method,path,key,body}); retain exact original create intent BEFORE dispatch. Repeated identical key/body is idempotent. Unknown outcomes remain owned without retry/rekey.
lease.retainDocument: async (documentId); register exact returned document including accepted responses with failed attribution
lease.release: async () -> {registered:true,parent_cleanup_barrier:true}; confirms all intents/resources remain in the parent final database cleanup ledger, not that they were deleted

requirements: Every document is created via POST /api/v1/documents with a fresh single-intent key
No public document delete exists. Parent must own the exact disposable database and prevent aggregate campaign PASS until its final teardown is confirmed
Browse seeds 26 owned documents, one granted shared document and one inaccessible document for actual 25-row UI pagination
Comments seeds 26 real comments through POST and grants the viewer read-only access for actual UI pagination
Missing scope, identities or cleanup barrier throws BLOCKED before document writes; no production fallback
No direct Mongo access or manual repair from these modules

latency: Retain setup and operation timing separately; these offline author tests establish no runtime performance or two-AM feature PASS.
